question: A sum of money was invested at simple interest at r % per annum for 3 years. Had the rate of interest been (r + 2) %, it would have fetched Rs. 84 more. Find the sum invested.
solution:
Given:

A sum of money was invested at simple interest at r % per annum for 3 years. 

Had the rate of interest been (r + 2) %, it would have fetched Rs. 84 more.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the sum invested be Rs. P.

According to the question,

{P × (R + 2) × 3} over 100 - {P × R × 3} over 100 = 84

⇒ P × {3R + 6 - 3R} over 100 = 84

⇒ P = (84 ÷ 6) × 100

⇒ P = 1400

∴ The sum invested is Rs. 1400.
